blocks.text: BANGA, South Cotabato — Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian arrived here Sunday to check on victims and families affected by the deadly shooting at Banga National High School (BNHS). Gatchalian, who arrived shortly after 11 a.m., visited the victims, their parents and teachers affected by the Sept. 18 shooting. READ: Campus shooter ‘planned attack, warned
